parsed.name: ACQ2106-TIGA 模块化数据采集机箱
parsed.description: 这是一种模块化实验数据采集机箱，用于连接多个采集或数字 I/O 站点并完成瞬态信号采集、实时数据流传输以及实验触发/时序联动。根据暴露出的功能，它也可配合数字输出与模式发生资源，用于实验装置的触发控制和时序编排。
parsed.description_en: This is a modular laboratory data acquisition chassis used to host multiple acquisition or digital I/O sites for transient signal capture, live data streaming, and experiment trigger/timing coordination. Based on the exposed functions, it can also work with digital outputs and pattern-generation resources for trigger control and timing sequencing in lab setups.

actions.description: 向指定站点的 DIO482 模式/脉冲发生器加载时序列表。
actions.description_en: Load a timing or pattern list into the DIO482 pattern/pulse generator at the specified site.

actions.description: 设置指定站点的数字输出状态。
actions.description_en: Set the digital output state at the specified site.
